tools.name: riseai_query_wallets
tools.description: Find store credit wallets (one per customer balance), enriched with gift card and contact information. Use the filter for an email or customer reference. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/wallets/query.

tools.name: riseai_query_wallet_actions
tools.description: List store credit actions (issued, redeemed, refunded, disabled) on wallets, with amounts and dates. Use it for a wallet's transaction history. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/wallet_actions/query.

tools.name: riseai_query_orders
tools.description: Find gift card orders with their status and fulfilment details. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/orders/query.

tools.name: riseai_query_gift_cards
tools.description: Find gift cards by code, recipient, status or balance. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/gift-cards/query.

tools.name: riseai_query_gift_card_transactions
tools.description: List balance changes (increases, decreases, redemptions) on gift cards. Rise API: POST /v1/rise/gift-cards/transactions/query.

tools.name: riseai_get_gift_card
tools.description: Get one gift card by id, with its code, balance, status and expiry. Rise API: GET /v1/rise/gift-cards/{giftCardId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: riseai_query_wallet_actions, riseai_query_gift_card_transactions · Private data: riseai_query_wallets, riseai_query_wallet_actions · Public sink: riseai_query_wallets, riseai_query_wallet_actions, riseai_query_orders, riseai_query_gift_cards, riseai_query_gift_card_transactions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: riseai_query_wallet_actions, riseai_query_gift_card_transactions · Private data: riseai_query_wallets, riseai_query_wallet_actions · Public sink: riseai_query_wallets, riseai_query_wallet_actions, riseai_query_orders, riseai_query_gift_cards, riseai_query_gift_card_transactions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
